description: Fluvial flood risk assessment in rural settlements along the Sirba River in Niger is a hazard data set listed in DataCite country sweep of research-data repositories (Africa), a research data metadata index, published or maintained by Mendeley. This dataset contains the key information to estimate the fluvial flood risk in the 4 main settlements along the River Sirba, Niger. The hypothesis is that fluvial flood hazard has increased in recent years and that many exposed assets remain in the riparian communities. Coverage: Niger. The portal files it under the publisher Mendeley. Its tags are Applied Sciences, Social Sciences. The repository dates the deposit 2021; no later update was checked. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-dc-portal.
